svg.aria-label: Development switches and smoke checks. NULL_MINI_EXIT_WHEN_READY=1: Exit after the page loads; no prompt is sent NULL_MINI_NO_SHORTCUT=1: Show at startup without claiming Control+Space NULL_MINI_SMOKE="<text>": Send a real harness prompt, log the reply, exit without a window; also SMOKE_MODEL and SMOKE_STOP_AFTER (seconds) NULL_MINI_SELFTEST="<text>": Type into the real page, a line at a time, each once the page has stopped working: a message, a command, a choice from a list, an answer to a sign-in. A line that ends in " &" does not wait for its reply. Then log what the page shows and exit NULL_MINI_PROFILE=<name>: Pass an isolated profile to OMP and use profile-specific Null settings and harness-settings files NULL_MINI_BACKUPS="m/one,m/two": Override the backup order for this run without changing the saved order NULL_MINI_UPDATES=<address>: Where /update reads which Oh-my-pi is checked, in place of the repository: a made-up file as a file:// address NULL_MINI_RELEASE=<address>: Where /update learns which Null is the newest, in place of GitHub: a made-up address whose last part is a tag, null-v0.2.0 NULL_MINI_FOLDER=<path>: Run on that folder in place of yours, made if missing: OMP's folder, its MCP definitions and Null's own files are all under it, so a new one is a Mac with nothing signed in NULL_MINI_LINK_COPY=<folder>: Make Null's copy of the browser link's extension in that folder, as /browser makes it, and exit without a window; LINK_ENGINE names the Oh-my-pi to make it from. For a Chrome of its own, such as the bench's NULL_MINI_STANDIN=1: Offer a stand-in provider in that folder, so a message is answered or refused with no real sign-in: standin-anthropic/ok, /limit, /auth, /noaccess, and /slow, which says the message back a word at a time; the same for openai and codex; needs FOLDER. Told to by a message's last line (ask the shell: <command>), standin-anthropic/ok asks the harness for that tool, as a model would $ NULL_MINI_EXIT_WHEN_READY=1 NULL_MINI_NO_SHORTCUT=1 \ $ NULL_MINI_PROFILE=null-probe ./target/debug/null-mini $ NULL_MINI_FOLDER=/tmp/null-run NULL_MINI_STANDIN=1 NULL_MINI_SMOKE=ping \ $ NULL_MINI_SMOKE_MODEL=standin-anthropic/ok ./target/debug/null-mini Profile isolation does not isolate MCP: definitions still come from the normal ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json, and smoke or self-test prompts can call those servers and run real tools. The startup-only check above sends no prompt. A run on a folder of its own reads none of that and leaves nothing behind but the folder; a local model server on this Mac, such as Ollama, is still found.

g.text: Development switches and smoke checks
NULL_MINI_EXIT_WHEN_READY=1
Exit after the page loads; no prompt is sent
NULL_MINI_NO_SHORTCUT=1
Show at startup without claiming Control+Space
NULL_MINI_SMOKE="<text>"
Send a real harness prompt, log the reply, exit without a window;
also SMOKE_MODEL and SMOKE_STOP_AFTER (seconds)
NULL_MINI_SELFTEST="<text>"
Type into the real page, a line at a time, each once the page has
stopped working: a message, a command, a choice from a list, an
answer to a sign-in. A line that ends in " &" does not wait for its
reply. Then log what the page shows and exit
NULL_MINI_PROFILE=<name>
Pass an isolated profile to OMP and use profile-specific Null
settings and harness-settings files
NULL_MINI_BACKUPS="m/one,m/two"
Override the backup order for this run without changing the saved
order
NULL_MINI_UPDATES=<address>
Where /update reads which Oh-my-pi is checked, in place of the
repository: a made-up file as a file:// address
NULL_MINI_RELEASE=<address>
Where /update learns which Null is the newest, in place of GitHub: a
made-up address whose last part is a tag, null-v0.2.0
NULL_MINI_FOLDER=<path>
Run on that folder in place of yours, made if missing: OMP's folder,
its MCP definitions and Null's own files are all under it, so a new
one is a Mac with nothing signed in
NULL_MINI_LINK_COPY=<folder>
Make Null's copy of the browser link's extension in that folder, as
/browser makes it, and exit without a window; LINK_ENGINE names the
Oh-my-pi to make it from. For a Chrome of its own, such as the
bench's
NULL_MINI_STANDIN=1
Offer a stand-in provider in that folder, so a message is answered or
refused with no real sign-in: standin-anthropic/ok, /limit, /auth,
/noaccess, and /slow, which says the message back a word at a time;
the same for openai and codex; needs FOLDER. Told to by a message's
last line (ask the shell: <command>), standin-anthropic/ok asks the
harness for that tool, as a model would
dominionism@null
NULL_MINI_EXIT_WHEN_READY=1 NULL_MINI_NO_SHORTCUT=1 \
dominionism@null
NULL_MINI_PROFILE=null-probe ./target/debug/null-mini
dominionism@null
NULL_MINI_FOLDER=/tmp/null-run NULL_MINI_STANDIN=1 NULL_MINI_SMOKE=ping \
dominionism@null
NULL_MINI_SMOKE_MODEL=standin-anthropic/ok ./target/debug/null-mini

The startup-only check above sends no prompt. A run on a folder of its own reads none of that and
leaves nothing behind but the folder; a local model server on this Mac, such as Ollama, is still
found.
